mapper.update: UPDATE USER SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE USER_ROLE SET role_id = #{roleId} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE SUPPORT SET status = #{status} WHERE support_id = #{supportId}
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER) as totalUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') as activeUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SUPPORT WHERE status = 'PENDING') as pendingFeedbacks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_ROLE ur JOIN ROLE r ON ur.role_id = r.role_id WHERE r.role_code IN ('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN')) as adminCount

SELECT ec.emotion_name as label, COUNT(ma.analysis_id) as value, 'violet' as color FROM MESSAGE_ANALYSIS ma JOIN EMOTION_CATEGORY ec ON ma.dominant_emotion_id = ec.emotion_id GROUP BY ec.emotion_id, ec.emotion_name
SELECT c.name as label, COUNT(p.post_id) as value FROM POST p JOIN CATEGORY c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%H:00') as label, COUNT(*) as value FROM MESSAGE WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 8 HOUR) GROUP BY label ORDER BY label ASC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT chat_room_id) FROM CHAT_ROOM WHERE updated_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
SELECT AVG(activity_score) FROM USER_ACTIVITY_DAILY WHERE activity_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
mapper.update: UPDATE USER SET nickname = #{nickname}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: UPDATE USER SET status = 'DELETED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select:
SELECT log_id as id, actor, actor_role as actorRole, category, action, target, detail, created_at as createdAt FROM ADMIN_ACTION_LOG
AND (actor LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR target LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR detail LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND category = #{category}
AND actor = #{actor}
AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 120
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ADMIN_ACTION_LOG (actor, actor_role, category, action, target, detail, created_at) VALUES ( #{log.actor}, #{log.actorRole}, #{log.category}, #{log.action}, #{log.target}, #{log.detail}, NOW() )
